products.product_description: Macaroni Salad with Cheddar Cheese is packaged in a plastic bag, each case contains 2/5 lbs. bags. The label listed item #23070 and the UPC 8 87241 80712 0. The product was also sold both in Zupans Markets service deli salad case, sized to order, and available in prepacked round plastic containers (8, 12 & 16 oz.) in its Grab & Go area. Scale label on bottom of the product container reads Macaroni Salad with Cheddar Cheese with code 394.
products.reason_for_recall: Macaroni Salad with Cheddar Cheese is recalled due to the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. This product contains affected green peas that were recalled by National Frozen Foods Company.
